scope: All 18 actual outputs across three six-case old development trials; no fresh v3 evaluation.
methodology: Complete source/output pairs were read; automatic lexical flags are not semantic approval.
Context trial includes only bounded neighboring original source text. It includes no reference translations or case-specific repairs.
Sampling trial uses temperature 0.7, top_p 0.6, top_k 20, repeat_penalty 1.05 and seed 0; 2048 output-token and 8192 context guards remain from the app. There was no repeated random-seed selection.
Prototype patches and exact source commit/hash identify code differing from the main app. Neither experiment was adopted.
Assistant review of internally authored cases is not blinded human evaluation or a general accuracy rate.
